pairs.subject: document-text-extraction
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/markdown.rs:341 The HTML-to-Markdown converter blanket-replaces every pipe in a table cell and otherwise copies text runs into markup unchanged, so characters that parse as Markdown syntax are not escaped from the assembled output.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:401 html_to_markdown returns a String and drops whole subtrees such as form, so a content-bearing region is omitted with no region list on the result.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:61 text_len_capped is a per-page character-count shortcut, not a readability screen later confirmed by extraction.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:58 Re-acquisition is reduced to one character threshold, with no complete/sparse/corrupt/empty band and no measurement stored beside it.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:186 An img becomes alt Markdown; this module has no scanned-page or optical-recognition path whose boundary would need publishing.
crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:357 The eval forces an empty cheap path and grades the model answer; it does not choose between two non-empty readings.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:189 Heading level is copied from the source tag name; there is no local-census structural classifier.

crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:262 The length window is a bare constant with no constructed damage corpus, threshold sweep, or reader binding; the pass baseline is the recorded model's own score.
crates/core/src/markdown.rs:275 The walker visits each parsed child once; this module adds no repeat or reference expansion construct.

crates/core/src/markdown.rs:341 Only table-cell pipes are escaped, and every pipe is escaped after the cell is assembled; push_text copies other text characters straight into the markup, including html_fragment_to_markdown output a caller will embed.

pairs.registryProposal: The Rust application rust--context-decided-escaping.md describes a shipped lookahead escaper for this repository's Markdown converter, but markdown.rs still writes text through push_text and blanket-replaces only '|'. The application and the tree disagree, so that write-up is not evidence the technique is implemented.
